title: Don't buy it.
text: Don't buy it.. [[VIDEOID:cd6079163ba4c6e34dc6e8cab6734caf]] Assembled following the instructions provided. I stopped putting it together when the door measurements weren't adding up. It had potential, but this is just cheap and unusable.

product_metadata.title: Haotian BZR34-HG, Grey Bathroom Tall Cabinet with 1 Drawer, 2 Doors and Adjustable Shelves, Bathroom Shelf, 7.87 x 7.87 x 70.87 Bathroom Tall Cabinet Cupboard
features: It features 1 drawer, 5 storage compartments and 2 cupboards with internal adjustable shelves, providing ample storage space for you.
All shelves are adjustable, offering a customized storage experience for you.
Made of high quality MDF in grey lacquer. Durable and good looking.
